# Xorg's XKB lock state across keymap reloads, and its state/indicator notifies (issue #253):
# Xvfb -noreset, fresh server per case, layout=gb
# server: X.Org version 21.1.25 (xdpyinfo); `Xvfb -version` -> "Unrecognized option: -version" (not supported by this build)
# pacman -Q: xkeyboard-config 2.48-1 xorg-server-xvfb 21.1.25-1
# each case: setxkbmap -rules evdev -model pc105 -layout gb; then tools/xkb-mutation-probe.c
# -s DETAILS with the case's steps: lock:AFFECT:MODS = XkbLockModifiers, lockgroup:N =
# XkbLockGroup, down/up = XTEST, 'run:setxkbmap ... -layout L' = a reload (XkbGetKbdByName),
# state = GetState + GetIndicatorState (Xorg's GetState leaves grab/lookup 0). 'e xkb' is a
# listener selecting everything, 'e xkbs' one selecting only StateNotify with DETAILS. The
# probe's per-key map diff and coremodmap lines are filtered out. In raw event hex the
# sequence number (bytes 2-3) and time (4-7) differ between runs.
## case reload-numlock-lockmods: -s 08: NumLock locked by request, reload to de, then Caps Lock pressed and released
